caption: The drawing depicts a square cloth with intricate embroidery patterns, rendered in shades of light brown and gray pencil on off-white paper. The cloth's surface is decorated with an array of floral and leaf motifs arranged in swirling patterns across its entire area. At the center of the cloth is a woven basket containing blooming flowers, with more sprigs extending outward. To the left of the basket is a bird with extended wings, and to the right are two clusters of flowers. Faint text near the top center reads "Eliza Suydam, New York. 1816." in cursive letters, with "1816." appearing again in a smaller print to the right. The bottom corners of the cloth feature a diamond-shaped grid pattern. The edges of the fabric are slightly undulating, and a strip of brown material is attached to the left side of the image, possibly a label or a hinge. The drawing is highly detailed and fills most of the page, leaving a narrow margin around the cloth.
title: Padded Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
